avis.texte: • Provides nourishment and hydration to the skin, instant GLOW 🌾 • Enriched with rice extract for moisturizing and brightening benefits • Delivers intense hydration for a plump and revitalized complexion • Works on my sensitive skin • High-quality and effective formula

avis.titre: Rice Extract that brightens, hydrates and helps skin retain
avis.texte: The I'm From Rice Toner is formulated with 77.78% Rice Extract that brightens, hydrates and helps skin retain moisture, resulting in a softer, smoother texture. Rice is sourced from Yeoju in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. The toner forms a protective layer on the skin to prevent transepidermal water loss, remove dead skin cells and moisturize. Perfect for dry, dull and irritated skin types. Other notable ingredients include: Niacinamide, Purslane Extract and Adenosine.
